complaining.label: Complaining / Criticising
complaining.when: to point out what went wrong or fell short

phrases.t: By far the worst aspect of …
The thing that annoyed me most was …
One criticism I would make about … is that …
If I had one complaint, it would be …

tasks.question: What did you find most disappointing about your last holiday?

models: The hotel room was far from ideal, since it smelled strongly of damp, which meant that I barely slept during the stay.
By far the worst aspect of the trip was the flight being delayed for six hours, which really spoiled the start of our holiday.
The thing that annoyed me most was finding the beach covered in litter, because we had chosen the resort specifically for its scenery.

cues.cue: tour guide / rush / through every stop
models: One criticism I would make about the tour is that the guide rushed through every stop, which meant we never had time to properly explore.

cues.cue: food / turn out / to be overpriced and bland
models: What made the food really disappointing was how overpriced and bland it turned out to be, especially since the menu had promised local specialities.
The main concern about the hotel is the constant noise from building work outside, especially when you're trying to relax by the pool.

tasks.question: What criticisms would you make of a restaurant that let you down?

models: A serious shortcoming of the restaurant was the painfully slow service, and this made even a quick lunch take over an hour.
The seating arrangement was far from ideal, since the tables felt cramped and uncomfortable, which meant that we struggled to enjoy the meal.

cues.cue: waiter / get / our order wrong twice
models: It was hard to overlook the fact that the waiter got our order wrong twice, which spoiled what should have been a relaxing evening.
I found the portion sizes quite disappointing, particularly when you consider how much the meal cost.

cues.cue: kitchen / run out / of half the menu
models: If I had one complaint, it would be that the kitchen had run out of half the menu, since we ended up settling for our third choice.

cues.cue: background music / play / far too loudly
models: The main concern about the restaurant is that the background music plays far too loudly, especially when you're trying to have a conversation.

tasks.question: What was the worst thing about a course or class you took?

models: By far the worst aspect of the course was that the lecturer simply read straight from the slides, which really spoiled any sense of engagement.

cues.cue: materials / be / outdated and hard to follow
models: One criticism I would make about the course is that the materials were outdated and hard to follow, which meant students often felt lost.

cues.cue: class sizes / be / far too large
models: The main concern about the course is that class sizes are far too large, especially when you need individual feedback.
What made the course really disappointing was that assignments received feedback weeks late, especially since deadlines for the next task had already passed.
The online platform was far from ideal, since it crashed repeatedly during exams, which meant that many students lost valuable time.
The thing that annoyed me most was that tutors cancelled sessions without warning, because we had rearranged our schedules specifically to attend.

tasks.question: What would you complain about regarding a product you bought?

cues.cue: product / stop / working after a week
models: The product was far from ideal, since it stopped working after just a week, which meant I had to request a replacement immediately.
One criticism I would make about the product is that the instructions are confusing and incomplete, which meant setup took far longer than expected.

cues.cue: customer service / take / days to respond
models: The main concern about the company is that customer service takes days to respond, especially when you need urgent help.
By far the worst aspect of the order was that the packaging arrived damaged, which really spoiled my first impression of the brand.

cues.cue: quality / fail / to match the price
models: I found the overall quality quite poor, particularly when you consider how much the item cost.
If I had one complaint, it would be that the refund process proved needlessly complicated, since I had to contact support three separate times.

tasks.question: What let you down about a hotel you stayed in?

models: The thing that annoyed me most was that check-in took almost an hour, because we had already had a long day of travelling.

cues.cue: room / not / match the photos online
models: What made the room really disappointing was that it didn't match the photos online at all, especially since we had booked based on those images.
A serious shortcoming of the hotel was that the pool remained closed for maintenance throughout our stay, and this made the extra cost feel unjustified.

cues.cue: breakfast / offer / a very limited selection
models: The breakfast was far from ideal, since it offered a very limited selection, which meant that we often ate out instead.
The main concern about the hotel is that the staff seem indifferent to complaints, especially when guests raise genuine issues.
It was hard to overlook how constantly the wifi cut out, which spoiled our ability to work remotely during the trip.

tasks.question: What was disappointing about a film or book you experienced recently?

cues.cue: plot / drag / in the middle section
models: One criticism I would make about the film is that the plot drags badly in the middle section, which meant my attention started to wander.
By far the worst aspect of the book was how rushed and unsatisfying the ending felt, which really spoiled an otherwise strong story.
The main concern about the film is that the characters lack any real depth, especially when the plot relies so heavily on emotional investment.
I found the special effects quite disappointing, particularly when you consider the size of the budget.
The dialogue was far from ideal, since it often sounded stiff and unnatural, which meant the performances felt less convincing.

cues.cue: pacing / lose / momentum after the first act
models: What made the second half really disappointing was how the pacing lost momentum after the first act, especially since the opening had been so gripping.
